name: Bearded Devil
summary: A devil with a writhing beard that wounds with a glaive and a poisonous beard.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The devil has {ref:glossary/advantage} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The devil makes one Beard attack and one Infernal Glaive attack.

actions.name: Beard
actions.onHit: and the target has the {ref:condition/poisoned} condition until the start of the devil's next turn. Until this poison ends, the target can't regain {ref:glossary/hit-points}.

actions.name: Infernal Glaive
actions.onHit: If the target is a creature and doesn't already have an infernal wound, it is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* {dc:con}. *Failure:* The target receives an infernal wound. While wounded, the target loses {dmg:1d10} {ref:glossary/hit-points} at the start of each of its turns. The wound closes after 1 minute, after a spell restores Hit Points to the target, or after the target or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to stanch the wound, doing so by succeeding on a {dc=12} Wisdom (Medicine) check.
